title: Fix Codex pane detection when the prompt mentions claude
body:
Bug: Session::icon_kind() can report Claude for a Codex pane. src/icons.rs IconKind::from_argv joins argv into one string and tests contains("claude") BEFORE "codex", so `foreman open codex "...claude..."` (a Codex worker whose prompt mentions claude) is classified Claude. Separately, the proc::agent_for process scan refreshes every 1.5s (REFRESH_EVERY), so detection lags right after an agent exits back to the shell.

Why it matters now: the Codex chat-submit fix (sibling card in plan "Codex chat delivery") must send its key only to Codex panes. A wrong Claude verdict silently skips the fix; a stale Codex verdict sends Insert to a plain shell (cmd.exe toggles overtype).

Do:
- Write a failing regression first (bug-fix rule): from_argv on a codex argv whose prompt contains "claude" must yield Codex.
- Fix from_argv to classify by the executable (argv[0] basename / first program token), not substring of the whole joined line.
- Expose a Codex check for chat delivery that prefers the provider from the agent's own hooks (AgentStateSlot.source == SourceAgent::Codex, src/agent_state.rs) and falls back to icon_kind(). Keep visibility narrow.

Acceptance: regression red on old code, green after; existing icon/agent-state tests pass.
Gates: cargo fmt --check; cargo test (use --target-dir target/agent when running inside foreman).
